floor_hint.sr: Dodirni sto da uslužiš goste ili ispuniš muzičku želju.
floor_hint.en: Tap a table to serve guests or hear their song request.

song_idle.en: The band is waiting for your song.

song_popup_hint.sr: Pesma se čuje u celoj kafani. Pogledaj želje svih stolova.
song_popup_hint.en: Every table hears your choice. Keep everyone's requests in mind.

menu_hint.sr: Gosti biraju iz otključanog menija. Usluži ih dodirom na sto.
menu_hint.en: Guests order from the unlocked menu. Tap their table to serve.

band_hint.sr: Bolji bend, veći repertoar, bogatiji bakšiš.
band_hint.en: A better band, more songs, bigger tips.

upgrades_hint.en: Small steps toward a great kafana.

venues_hint.en: from the dive bar to the river

offline_title.sr: Kafana je radila i bez tebe.

offline_cap.sr: Dostignut je limit zarade dok te nema.
offline_cap.en: Your away earnings cap was reached.

conflict_body.sr: Izaberi napredak koji želiš da nastaviš. Druga kopija biće zamenjena.
conflict_body.en: Choose the progress to continue. The other copy will be replaced.

leaderboard_offline.sr: Lista će biti dostupna kada se poveže server. Kafana nastavlja da radi.
leaderboard_offline.en: The leaderboard will be available when the server is connected. Your kafana keeps running.

reset_body.sr: Novac, bend i unapređenja ovog uređaja biće obrisani. Ovo ne može da se poništi.
reset_body.en: This device's money, band and upgrades will be reset. This cannot be undone.

sound_stub.sr: Zvuk i muzika čekaju snimke. Podešavanja se čuvaju.
sound_stub.en: Audio hooks are ready for recordings. Your preferences are saved.

sync_starting.sr: Igra se čuva na ovom uređaju

sync_mock.sr: Igra se čuva na ovom uređaju

notice.glass.en: Glass broken: cost {cost} din, bonus {bonus} din.
notice.glass.sr: Čaša je razbijena: trošak {cost} din, bonus {bonus} din.

purchase_table_limit.sr: Nema više mesta za stolove u ovom lokalu.
purchase_table_limit.en: This venue has no room for more tables.

hint_serve.en: Tap the bubble to serve the guests

hint_song.sr: Gosti žele pesmu, pusti im je!
hint_song.en: They want a song, play it!

venue_opened_body.sr: Ključevi su kod tebe. Gosti već čekaju na vratima.
venue_opened_body.en: The keys are yours. Guests are already at the door.

data.band_levels.solo_harmonikas.descrip.sr: Jedan čovek, jedna harmonika, ceo repertoar sela.
data.band_levels.solo_harmonikas.descrip.en: One man, one accordion, the whole village repertoire.

data.band_levels.trio.description.sr: Harmonika, gitara i bas. Sad može i narodnjaka.
data.band_levels.trio.description.en: Accordion, guitar and bass. Now pop-folk too.

data.band_levels.tamburaski_orkestar.des.sr: Pet tamburaša koji znaju svaku pesmu.
data.band_levels.tamburaski_orkestar.des.en: Five tamburica players who know every song.

data.band_levels.pevacica.description.sr: Orkestar i zvezda večeri, sa svojim hitovima.
data.band_levels.pevacica.description.en: The orchestra plus the star of the night, with her own hits.

data.events.tuca.text.sr: Dva stola su se posvađala oko pesme. Lete čaše.
data.events.tuca.text.en: Two tables are arguing over the song. Glasses are flying.

data.events.tuca.choices.izbaci.outcomes.sr: Izbačeni su, ali su polomili stolice.
data.events.tuca.choices.izbaci.outcomes.en: Thrown out, but they broke some chairs.

data.events.tuca.choices.runda.label.sr: Runda za sve na račun kuće
data.events.tuca.choices.runda.label.en: A round for everyone, on the house

data.events.tuca.choices.runda.outcomes..sr: Pomirili su se uz rakiju i zapevali zajedno.
data.events.tuca.choices.runda.outcomes..en: They made up over rakija and sang together.

data.events.tuca.choices.runda.outcomes..sr: Popili su rundu i nastavili da se svađaju.
data.events.tuca.choices.runda.outcomes..en: They drank the round and kept fighting.

data.events.tuca.choices.policija.outcom.sr: Policija je smirila situaciju. Gosti su se uplašili.
data.events.tuca.choices.policija.outcom.en: The police calmed things down. Guests got nervous.
The police brought an inspector along.

data.events.inspekcija.text.sr: Na vratima su dva inspektora sa fasciklama.
data.events.inspekcija.text.en: Two inspectors with folders are at the door.

data.events.inspekcija.choices.casti.out.sr: Popili su, pohvalili rakiju i otišli.
data.events.inspekcija.choices.casti.out.en: They drank, praised the rakija and left.

data.events.inspekcija.choices.casti.out.sr: Shvatili su to kao mito. Duplo veća kazna.
data.events.inspekcija.choices.casti.out.en: They took it as a bribe. Double fine.

data.events.inspekcija.choices.zatvori.o.en: The inspectors will come back another time.

data.events.svadba.text.sr: Kum pita da li mogu da proslave svadbu kod vas večeras.
data.events.svadba.text.en: The best man asks if they can hold the wedding party here tonight.

data.events.svadba.choices.prihvati.outc.sr: Svatovi stižu! Biće para, a možda i loma.
data.events.svadba.choices.prihvati.outc.en: The wedding party arrives! Money is coming, and maybe trouble.

data.events.svadba.choices.avans.outcome.en: The best man paid without a word.

data.events.svadba.choices.avans.outcome.sr: Kum se uvredio i odveo svatove drugde.
data.events.svadba.choices.avans.outcome.en: The best man took offence and went elsewhere.

data.events.svadba.choices.odbij.outcome.en: The evening goes on as usual.

data.events.nestanak_struje.text.sr: Nestalo je struje u celoj ulici.
data.events.nestanak_struje.text.en: The power is out on the whole street.

data.events.nestanak_struje.choices.svec.sr: Romantično je, ali kuhinja ne radi.
data.events.nestanak_struje.choices.svec.en: It's romantic, but the kitchen is down.

data.events.vip_gost.text.sr: Ušao je poznati pevač sa društvom.
data.events.vip_gost.text.en: A famous singer walked in with friends.

data.events.vip_gost.choices.sampanjac.o.sr: Oduševljen je. Ostavio je bogat bakšiš.
data.events.vip_gost.choices.sampanjac.o.en: Delighted. He left a huge tip.

data.events.vip_gost.choices.normalno.la.sr: Usluži ga kao i sve ostale

data.events.vip_gost.choices.normalno.ou.sr: Popio je piće i ostavio pristojan bakšiš.
data.events.vip_gost.choices.normalno.ou.en: He had a drink and left a decent tip.

data.events.vip_gost.choices.slika.label.sr: Zamoli ga za sliku za zid
data.events.vip_gost.choices.slika.label.en: Ask for a photo for the wall

data.events.vip_gost.choices.slika.outco.sr: Slika je na zidu. Svi dolaze da je vide.
data.events.vip_gost.choices.slika.outco.en: The photo is on the wall. Everyone comes to see it.

data.genres.starogradske.description.sr: Sentimentalne gradske pesme uz violinu i gitaru.
data.genres.starogradske.description.en: Sentimental urban ballads with violin and guitar.

data.genres.tamburica.description.sr: Vojvođanski tamburaški zvuk, bećarci i romanse.
data.genres.tamburica.description.en: Vojvodina tamburica sound, bećarac and romances.

data.genres.izvorna.description.sr: Narodna kola i pesme sa sela, uz harmoniku.
data.genres.izvorna.description.en: Village folk dances and songs on the accordion.

data.genres.narodnjaci.description.sr: Novokomponovana narodna muzika za lomljenje čaša.
data.genres.narodnjaci.description.en: Newly composed folk music for breaking glasses.

data.guest_types.penzioner.description.sr: Sedi dugo, troši malo, pamti kad je bilo bolje.
data.guest_types.penzioner.description.en: Stays long, spends little, remembers better days.

data.guest_types.studenti.description.sr: Glasni, nestrpljivi i uvek na ivici budžeta.
data.guest_types.studenti.description.en: Loud, impatient and always at the edge of their budget.

data.guest_types.ozalosceni.description.sr: Posle sahrane, za dušu pokojnika. Pogrešna pesma se ne prašta.
data.guest_types.ozalosceni.description.en: After the funeral, for the departed's soul. A wrong song is not forgiven.

data.guest_types.svatovi.description.sr: Veliko društvo, puno para, još više rakije.
data.guest_types.svatovi.description.en: Big party, lots of money, even more rakija.

data.guest_types.biznismen.description.sr: Nema vremena, ima para. Lepi bakšiš ako je sve po njegovom.
data.guest_types.biznismen.description.en: No time, lots of money. Tips big if everything goes his way.

data.upgrades.dodatni_sto.description.sr: Još jedan sto, do granice lokala.
data.upgrades.dodatni_sto.description.en: One more table, up to the venue's limit.

data.upgrades.ozvucenje.description.sr: Da se pesma čuje i u poslednjem ćošku.
data.upgrades.ozvucenje.description.en: So the song reaches the last corner.

data.upgrades.dekor.description.sr: Toplija atmosfera, gosti se duže dobro osećaju.
data.upgrades.dekor.description.en: A warmer room keeps guests happy longer.

data.upgrades.sef.description.sr: Kasa radi i dok vas nema — duže.
data.upgrades.sef.description.en: The till keeps earning longer while you're away.

data.upgrades.kuhinja.description.en: A faster kitchen keeps guests patient.

data.upgrades.knjigovodja.description.sr: Neko pazi na pare dok vas nema.
data.upgrades.knjigovodja.description.en: Someone minds the money while you're away.

data.venues.birtija.description.sr: Tri klimava stola i harmonikaš koji je video bolje dane.
data.venues.birtija.description.en: Three wobbly tables and an accordionist who has seen better days.

data.venues.kafana.description.sr: Prava kafana, sa stolnjacima i stalnim gostima.
data.venues.kafana.description.en: A proper kafana, with tablecloths and regulars.

data.venues.restoran.description.sr: Bela tehnika, beli stolnjaci, bele košulje konobara.
data.venues.restoran.description.en: White tablecloths, white shirts on the waiters.

data.venues.splav.description.sr: Splav na reci. Ovde se ide do zore.
data.venues.splav.description.en: A club on the river. Here the night lasts till dawn.
